reviewer.description: Independent read-only review. Default GPT-6.1 Sol; the parent passes another model when the implementer is GPT (see config/pi/README.md, Review pairing)

oracle.description: Read-only advisor (alias: advisor) for plan, architecture and decision-drift checks. Default Gemini 4 Carbon, outside the Claude implementer family; when the implementer is Gemini or GPT the parent passes cc/claude-fable-5-2 (see config/pi/README.md, Review pairing)

scout.description: Fast codebase recon that returns compressed context for handoff. Pinned to Haiku 5.5 (low): recon needs speed, not the parent's heavy model

researcher.description: Autonomous web researcher. Pinned to Gemini 4 Carbon medium (1M context) for source synthesis; evidence-auditor checks it from another family

evidence-auditor.description: Independent evidence reviewer. Pinned to GPT-6.1 Sol, outside the researcher's Gemini family, so claim checks stay independent
